info.title: Fake User API
info.description:
A free fake backend for front-end developers: 100 generated users with CRUD, JWT authentication and roles. All data is dummy and lives in memory.

Demo accounts (password `password123`): admin@example.com, moderator@example.com, user@example.com. Every seeded user shares that password.
